changes: Separated the monthly VIX measurement from the outcome bucket.
Recast VVIX and call buying as foreshadowing signals rather than causes.
Moved the year-end tame-volatility counteredge to the month-end measurement to restore chronology.
Retained the December 18 spike as a contributor rather than the sole cause of the monthly change.
caveats: Options activity and VVIX are anticipatory signals whose causal effect is not established.
The one-day spike does not by itself determine the month-end percentage change.
